text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains or losses do not reveal a reliable pattern; prices move randomly, so I should not try to predict the next move from recent history.","I should judge each holding by its future prospects and my overall portfolio plan, not cling to a purchase just to avoid admitting a mistake or sell merely to lock in a gain.","Losses feel especially painful to me, so I should make decisions calmly and keep risk diversified rather than let short-term account swings drive my trades."]}
